entry.text: lifemare — A coined word by Neill Groom for the act of complaining about life taken to the next level: the kind of grievance you didn't know you were nursing until you heard yourself voicing it. A nightmare wrought by life, not sleep. Carved by Neill Groom, May 14, 2026.
